purpose: Teach: 祐/俊/吾/遙/諒/ゆり/綾/朱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんのお友達の祐さんが家にいらした
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad's friend Yū used to visit our house.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft voice, unhurried pace. Eyes distant with memory. Let the recollection settle before speaking.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、俊さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and didn't you play shogi with Toshun when you were young?
lines.style: Warm, affirming, slightly teasing. Her voice lifts with the memory. Playful emphasis on 「あなた」 — not a challenge, an invitation to remember with her. Leans in slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「吾輩は猫である」を声に出して読まれた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father used to read *I Am a Cat* aloud to us.
lines.style: Quieter now, more inward. Pause before the title — almost reverent. Slow, careful articulation, like he's hearing the cadence of his father's voice again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、姪の遙ちゃんを可愛がられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And dear, didn't you dote on little Haruka when she was small?
lines.style: Gently insistent, affectionate. Her voice softens around 「可愛がられた」. Tender amusement — she's reminding him of his own sweetness, unguarded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが諒さんと音楽鑑賞を楽しまれた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father and Ryō used to enjoy music together.
lines.style: The faintest smile in his voice. Contemplative, unhurried. Slight warmth — the specific memory of two people absorbed in something they loved.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご近所のゆりさんと俳句を詠まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't you compose haiku with neighbor Yuri when you were young, dear?
lines.style: Brighter now, almost delighted. She's reclaiming his memories with him. Slight lift on 「詠まれた」 — pride in his quieter accomplishments. Familiar, intimate tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが妹の綾子さんを「綾」と呼ばれた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father called his sister Ayako by her short name — just Aya.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Gentle emphasis on the intimacy of the nickname. Slow. This detail carries a quiet weight — affection expressed simply.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、朱塗りのお椀を大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't you treasure that vermillion lacquer bowl when you were young, dear?
lines.style: Her voice wraps around this final memory with special care. Warm, close, intimate. Slight pause before 「大事に」 — this detail matters to her. Trailing smile at the end, like she's held this thought for a long time.
